productName: Acer Aspire 7 Intel Core i5 12th Gen (12450H, 16GB RAM, 512GB SSD, RTX 3050, 144Hz)
whyBest: It is the absolute best choice because it packs a dedicated RTX 3050 GPU and 16GB RAM under 50k, fitting your budget perfectly.
pros: Dedicated RTX 3050 GPU delivers actual entry-level gaming performance far superior to integrated graphics.
